factor_name: Broad Equity Selloff Conditioned Cross-Asset Reversal

calculation.description: Contrarian one-day cross-asset return signal activated after a same-day completed-session selloff in both SPX and NDX; signal is lagged for next-day prediction.

metrics.turnover_proxy: activation-conditioned daily signal refresh; regime activation rate 380 dates in validation sample
metrics.decay: 5D/10D not estimated because date-aligned complete forward panels were insufficient; admission uses 1D horizon

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate daily IC across 380 activated dates in the 15-asset universe; conservative interpretation required because activation-conditioned sample is smaller than all dates.

signal_provenance.method: date-aligned cross-sectional Spearman IC using all 15 tradable instruments, minimum 8 valid names/date
signal_provenance.macro_or_conditioning: SPX and NDX are tradable benchmark instruments used only as lagged conditioning observations
